$comment: The bank's fraud policy, version 1.0, as structured config. Source: the Fraud Policy section of data/HHGOA_IEEE/README.md. Every recommendation the agent makes must cite one of these rule ids, and the full policy text is also chunked into PolicyDoc vertices for GraphRAG retrieval. This file is the machine-readable index; the README is authoritative if the two ever disagree.

R1.title: Verify before you block on a weak signal
R1.text: If the case rests on a single signal (including a risk score alone) and assessed fraud probability is below 0.70, recommend VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER or STEP_UP_AUTH before any block. Blocking a legitimate customer on one signal is a policy breach.

R2.title: Customer denies the transaction
R2.text: Recommend BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE. Add FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

R3.title: Customer confirms the transaction
R3.text: Recommend CLOSE_NO_FRAUD. Note the confirmation in the case file.

R4.title: No reply within 24 hours
R4.text: Recommend MONITOR_CARD and DECLINE_TRANSACTION for pending authorizations. Escalate if exposure exceeds $500.

R5.title: Card testing
R5.text: Three or more small online authorizations on one card within an hour, followed by a larger purchase: recommend DECLINE_TRANSACTION and STEP_UP_AUTH. If a purchase over $100 has already cleared, recommend BLOCK_CARD.

R6.title: Shared origin
R6.text: When several cards show fraud from the same device profile, the same billing region, or the same recipient email in one window, name the shared element, recommend CREATE_CASE and FILE_REPORT, and MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS for every card that shares it.
R6.requires: Name the shared element explicitly in the evidence and the narrative.

R7.title: Disputed but legitimate
R7.text: When the customer disputes a charge that matches their own recurring pattern (same merchant, same amount, monthly), recommend CREATE_CASE, VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER, and WARN_CUSTOMER. Do not block.

R8.title: Escalate when uncertain and exposed
R8.text: If the verdict is uncertain and exposure exceeds $500, or the evidence conflicts, recommend ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.

R9.title: Undocumented patterns
R9.text: When activity fits none of the known patterns but the evidence shows coordinated or repeated abuse across customers, recommend CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST, and describe the pattern in your own words. Do not force it into a known category.
R9.requires: pattern_description must be filled with two or three sentences on what the pattern is, who it affects, and how it was found.

R10.title: Never block all cards without cause
R10.text: Never BLOCK_ALL_CARDS unless at least two of the customer's cards show confirmed fraud or the customer's credentials are confirmed compromised.

case_criteria.$comment: Policy section 3a. A case is internal and can be updated as evidence arrives.

sar_criteria.$comment: Policy section 3a. A report is a regulatory filing sent outside the bank. Most cases never need one. Deciding correctly between 'case only' and 'case plus report' is part of the next-best-action score.
and_any_of: activity connects to a shared device profile
activity connects to a shared region cluster
activity connects to another customer's fraud
the pattern is coordinated or undocumented (R9)
sar_criteria.narrative_length: six to twelve sentences, standing on its own without the case file

stopping_criteria.$comment: Policy section 6. Investigations that continue past a defensible decision waste time; investigations that stop before one create risk. Both are marked down.
stop_when_any: fraud_probability >= 0.85 or <= 0.15, supported by at least two independent pieces of evidence
a verification response settles the question
further steps are unlikely to change the decision

evidence_requests.$comment: Policy section 5. The agent may take these without approval. Customer and analyst replies are NOT provided by the dataset: simulate the response and state the assumption in the case file's evidence_requests.

escalation_guardrails.$comment: Not policy text, a build decision recorded here so the orchestrator has one place to read it. agent.md section 3 caps the evidence loop.
